module_title: UP Census 2011 - Foundational Matrix (Total Population, Literacy & Gender Metrics)
introduction: This foundational level targets the absolute baseline metrics of Uttar Pradesh's demography. For objective state exams, you must memorize the overall numbers alongside the top three and bottom three districts in each core category.

core_concepts.title: Total Population Baseline
core_concepts.description:
- **The Absolute Number:** UP's total population stands at **19,98,12,341** (approx. 19.98 Crore).
- **National Share:** UP accounts for a massive **16.51%** of India's total population. (If UP were a country, it would be the 5th most populous globally).
- **Highest Population Districts:** Prayagraj (Allahabad) > Moradabad > Ghaziabad.
- **Lowest Population Districts:** Mahoba < Chitrakoot < Hamirpur.

core_concepts.title: Literacy Rate Breakdown
core_concepts.description:
- **Average Literacy:** The state's average literacy rate is **67.7%** (Male: 77.3% | Female: 57.2%).
- **Highest Literacy District:** **Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida)** at 80.12%. (It also ranks 1st in Male Literacy, whereas Kanpur Nagar ranks 1st in Female Literacy).
- **Lowest Literacy District:** **Shravasti** (Notably, Shravasti records the lowest overall literacy, lowest male literacy, and lowest female literacy across the state).

core_concepts.title: Sex Ratio (Gender Balance)
core_concepts.description:
- **Average Sex Ratio:** UP's sex ratio is **912** females per 1000 males. This is significantly lower than the national average of 943.
- **Highest Sex Ratio Districts:** **Jaunpur (1024)** > Azamgarh (1019) > Deoria (1017).
- **Lowest Sex Ratio District:** Gautam Buddha Nagar (851).

important_entities.name: Jaunpur District
important_entities.significance: Jaunpur is the standout demographic anomaly in UP, boasting a sex ratio of 1024. It is one of the very few pockets where females outnumber males, making it a highly tested static fact.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: The Gautam Buddha Nagar Literacy vs. Sex Ratio Paradox
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Examiners heavily test this sociological paradox in multi-statement questions: Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida) is the **most literate** district in Uttar Pradesh, yet it simultaneously records the **lowest sex ratio (851)** in the state.
While Gautam Buddha Nagar sweeps overall and male literacy rankings, the district with the highest **Female Literacy** is actually **Kanpur Nagar**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: 67 Baseline: Add 10 for Men, Subtract 10 for Women.
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Memorize the baseline state literacy: **67.7%**. Add 10 to get Male literacy (**77.3%**), and subtract 10 to get Female literacy (**57.2%**).

exam_strategy_tips: In basic state screenings (like UP Police or VDO), 'Jaunpur' for highest sex ratio and 'Shravasti' for lowest literacy are the two most recycled one-liner facts. Commit them to memory immediately.
